name: When is it time to replace old bathroom tile with natural marble?

mainEntity.name: When is it time to replace old bathroom tile with natural marble?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing existing tile with marble when you want a permanent visual upgrade, or when existing tile systems show signs of failure. Loose tiles, deteriorating grout, soft spots in the subfloor, or persistent moisture leaks behind shower walls indicate that underlying backer boards and waterproofing have degraded. In those situations, a full tear-out is required anyway, making it the ideal time to upgrade to custom marble. Homeowners also switch to marble during full bathroom renovations, converting outdated tub-shower combos into custom walk-in showers with seamless, spa-like finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade when planning a full renovation or when cracked tiles, soft subfloors, and failing grout show that underlying waterproofing has failed.
